 "data": "flowchart LR
 UI[\"Streamlit frontend\"]
 Docs[\"Swagger UI and OpenAPI<br/>/docs · /openapi.json\"]

 subgraph Backend[\"FastAPI backend\"]
 App[\"Application entry point<br/>main.py\"]
 Health[\"Health check<br/>GET /health\"]
 Reports[\"Report routes<br/>api/reports.py\"]
 Schemas[\"Pydantic validation<br/>schemas/reports.py\"]

 Create[\"Create a draft<br/>POST /reports/manual<br/>POST /reports/generate\"]
 Read[\"Find and open reports<br/>GET /reports<br/>GET /reports/{report_id}\"]
 Review[\"Edit and manage saved reports<br/>PATCH /reports/{report_id}<br/>POST /reports/{report_id}/regenerate<br/>POST /reports/{report_id}/approve<br/>POST /reports/{report_id}/reopen<br/>DELETE /reports/{report_id}\"]
 Download[\"Download saved PDF<br/>GET /reports/{report_id}/download\"]

 Client[\"Ollama client<br/>llm/ollama.py\"]
 Prompt[\"DAP prompt<br/>dap_generation.txt\"]
 Store[\"Report storage<br/>db/drafts.py and db/connection.py\"]
 PDF[\"PDF renderer<br/>export/pdf.py\"]
 end

 Ollama[\"Local Ollama server\"]
 SQLite[(\"Local SQLite database\")]
 Template[\"School DAP PDF template\"]

 UI <-->|\"HTTP requests and responses\"| App
 App --> Docs
 App --> Health
 App --> Reports
 Reports --> Schemas
 Reports --> Create
 Reports --> Read
 Reports --> Review
 Reports --> Download

 Create -->|\"AI-assisted generation\"| Client
 Review -->|\"AI regeneration\"| Client
 Prompt --> Client
 Client <-->|\"POST /api/chat\"| Ollama
 Client -->|\"Validate Data, Assessment, and Plan\"| Schemas

 Create -->|\"Save notes and draft\"| Store
 Read -->|\"List, filter, or retrieve\"| Store
 Review -->|\"Check revision and status before writing\"| Store
 Download -->|\"Load saved report\"| Store
 Store <--> SQLite
 Download -->|\"Render draft or approved report\"| PDF
 Template --> PDF

 class UI frontend;
 class App,Docs,Health,Reports,Schemas,Create,Read,Review backend;
 class Client,Prompt,Ollama ai;
 class Store,SQLite storage;
 class Download,PDF,Template export;",
